limitations: The two runtime-probe requests observed one isolate and one module-scoped ManagedRuntime construction; this does not prove that every Cloudflare isolate globally reused the same isolate identity.
The account billing-subscription endpoint remained forbidden, so this proof does not establish a specific paid plan or future cost.
nonClaims: This Preview receipt does not prove Production, rollback, teardown, custom-domain, DNS, release, publication or public-domain behavior.
Screenshots supplement and do not replace the provider, HTTP, browser, accessibility, console or cache-header oracles.
